items.claim: Eryk Anders survived a decision against Joel Alvarez by a miracle and stopped fighting for 90 seconds during the bout.
items.quote: in the Joel Alvarez fight it was a miracle he lasted to decision there. At one point in the fight, he stopped fighting for about 90 seconds

items.claim: Eryk Anders is completely washed at this stage of his career.
items.quote: I think Luke is completely washed at this point.

items.claim: Eryk Anders' recent win was against Kelvin Gastelum who is also washed and competing in the wrong weight class.
items.quote: he was going up against someone who is also completely washed in Kelvin Gastelum in the wrong weight class

items.claim: Eryk Anders moving up in weight at this point in his career is a negative sign.
items.quote: So, Lu moving up in way at this point in time, it's it's not a good sign.

items.claim: Eryk Anders possesses more skill than Tresean Gore.
items.quote: Vente Luke is more skillful than Tong Gore.

items.claim: Tresean Gore has demonstrated toughness and resilience throughout his UFC career.
items.quote: Tong Gore has shown me toughness and resilience in his UFC career.

items.claim: Tresean Gore has good takedown defense and big power.
items.quote: He's got really good takedown defense. He's got big power.

items.claim: Tresean Gore is somewhat chinny and prone to getting hurt.
items.quote: Gore is a bit chinny. He gets hurt.
